metadata.title: Dedicated Access Workstation (DAW) Windows SSPP
metadata.remarks: Operating system–specific System Security and Privacy Plan defining how Microsoft Windows endpoints implement the Dedicated Access Workstation (DAW) trust tier.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A Microsoft Windows Dedicated Access Workstation configured as a single-purpose, maximal-assurance execution environment for privileged operations and Level 4 data access.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: This Windows SSPP inherits all DAW requirements, including all COBO L2 and COBO L1 inherited constraints.

props.name: supported-versions
props.remarks: Only currently supported Windows 11 releases approved for DAW use are permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: DAW Windows endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: DAW Windows endpoint is centrally enrolled, governed, and monitored.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: General productivity applications (email, web browsing, collaboration, office suites) are prohibited.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Windows DAW identity must use TPM-backed non-exportable keys, PKI-issued device certificates, and hardware attestation.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: All cryptographic operations must use FIPS 140-3 validated modules.

props.name: secure-boot-and-measurement
props.remarks: UEFI Secure Boot, measured boot, and attestation enforcement are mandatory.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Windows DAW configuration applies CIS Windows Benchmarks Level 2 and applicable DISA STIG requirements.

props.name: credential-protection
props.remarks: Virtualization-Based Security, Credential Guard, and Hypervisor-Enforced Code Integrity (HVCI) must be enabled.

props.name: defender-advanced-protection
props.remarks: Advanced Microsoft Defender features including endpoint isolation and tamper protection must be enabled.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network connectivity is restricted to approved admin endpoints, brokers, and control planes only.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Windows DAW endpoints are required for workflows involving Level 4 data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: DAW status does not confer automatic entitlement to Level 4 data; all access remains governed by Secure Data policies.

props.name: privileged-workloads-only
props.remarks: DAWs may be used only for privileged administration, security operations, and high-risk institutional workflows.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Enrollment, suspension, recovery, and retirement require elevated approval and enhanced auditability for DAWs.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines how Windows implements the DAW trust tier through maximal isolation, strict configuration baselines, strong hardware-backed identity, and continuous posture assurance.

control-implementation.remarks: Windows DAW security baselines, Group Policy/MDM configurations, Defender policies, and attestation workflows implement this SSPP and are maintained as controlled, versioned artifacts.
